function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (api.state.selectedRecord != event.payload.row.sys_id.value) {
        var unsavedChanges = api.data.record_form.unsavedChanges;
        if (unsavedChanges == undefined || JSON.parse(unsavedChanges).length == 0) {
            api.setState('selectedRecord', event.payload.row.sys_id.value);
            api.setState('selectedNumber', event.payload.row.displayValue.value);
        } else {
            var showPopup = false;
            unsavedChanges = JSON.parse(unsavedChanges);
            for (var i = 0; i < unsavedChanges.length; i++) {
                if (unsavedChanges[i].value.toString() != unsavedChanges[i].originalValue.toString()) {
                    showPopup = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (showPopup) {
                helpers.modal.open("[component-id$='confirm_and_destroy_1']");
                api.setState('nextNumber', event.payload.row.displayValue.value);
                api.setState('nextRecord', event.payload.row.sys_id.value);
            } else {
                api.setState('selectedRecord', event.payload.row.sys_id.value);
                api.setState('selectedNumber', event.payload.row.displayValue.value);
            }
        }
    }

}]]></script>
